hook.name: MevHookUpgradeableV10
hook.description: UUPS-upgradeable MEV protection hook that gates swaps via EIP-712 signatures from authorized signers or a block-level MEV unlock mechanism. ETH payments from MEV searchers are redistributed to the pool and a fee recipient after a configurable fee deduction, with admin-controlled blacklisting of tx.origin addresses and a minimum MEV payment threshold.
